info.title: Bicho core API
info.description: Self-hosted OTLP/HTTP and Sentry SDK error ingestion, append-only evidence, authenticated investigation reads, explicit issue state and MCP issue-status updates. This file is repository documentation only: the Worker serves no OpenAPI/Swagger/docs route. CORS preflights and automatic HEAD responses on read routes are transport behavior, not listed operations.

host.description: Replace with your deployment hostname; never put credentials here.

post.description: Sentry protocol v7 authentication via query, X-Sentry-Auth or envelope DSN (envelope endpoint only). All supplied credentials and route project must agree; DSN origin must match this installation. Secret-enabled projects additionally require X-Bicho-Secret or matching sentry_secret. Query/header authentication requires sentry_version=7. 2 MiB wire/decoded body, 1 MiB per event, 100 envelope items, 32 nesting levels and 20000 JSON values per parsed object. Raw JSON legacy store only; no base64 wrapping. Gzip/deflate supported via Content-Encoding. Unsupported envelope items are discarded and counted without storage. Batch validation precedes persistence. Whole failures use 429/503; after an accepted prefix HTTP 200 reports rejected IDs without encouraging whole-envelope retry. SDKs may ignore the partial response body. Reuse event_id when explicitly resending individual rejected events.

200.description: Accepted error event IDs, rejected IDs and discarded unsupported-item counts. Quota-limited partial success may include X-Sentry-Rate-Limits.

X-Sentry-Rate-Limits.description: Sentry error-category backoff, also present on 429.

post.description: Primary OTLP/HTTP input: JSON protobuf mapping or binary protobuf ExportLogsServiceRequest. Resolve the project by its unique ingest key, not resource attributes. Accept exception records at any severity and plain ERROR/FATAL logs; unsupported records are counted in partialSuccess. Support gzip and uncompressed bodies with decoded-byte limits. Optional log.record.uid enables project-scoped retry deduplication; correlation IDs are not occurrence IDs. No traces, metrics or gRPC receiver. Request validation follows the OTLP specification; the OpenAPI schema is a structural outline, not the full protobuf schema.

parameters.name: X-Bicho-Secret
parameters.description: Required only for projects provisioned with --secret; ingest-only, never an admin credential.

200.description: OTLP ExportLogsServiceResponse. An empty object indicates full success; partialSuccess counts rejected records. Accepted records are durable. Clients must not retry populated partial-success responses.

400.description: Invalid OTLP body or record count. Body is google.rpc.Status in the request encoding (JSON for an unsupported content type).

403.description: Missing/invalid ingest key or required secret. Body is google.rpc.Status in the request encoding (JSON for an unsupported content type).

405.description: Only POST and OPTIONS are supported. Body is google.rpc.Status in the request encoding (JSON for an unsupported content type).

413.description: Wire, decompressed input or record size exceeds a limit. Body is google.rpc.Status in the request encoding (JSON for an unsupported content type).

415.description: Unsupported content type or compression. Body is google.rpc.Status in the request encoding (JSON for an unsupported content type).

429.description: Quota exceeded before any records were accepted; honor Retry-After. Body is google.rpc.Status in the request encoding (JSON for an unsupported content type).

503.description: Temporary storage failure before acceptance; ambiguous delivery may duplicate records without a stable UID. Body is google.rpc.Status in the request encoding (JSON for an unsupported content type).

post.description: Creates a project with a unique server-generated numeric-string ID and random ingest credentials. Never replaces an existing project. Credentials are returned only here; store them securely. Each request creates a new project, so do not retry blindly after a lost response. Body is limited to 4096 wire/decoded bytes.

name.description: Trimmed before storage; whitespace-only names are rejected.

secret.description: Require an additional backend-only ingest secret.

201.description: Project registered. Includes ingest credentials; never an admin token or secret hash.

get.summary: List project IDs, names and quotas
get.description: Does not return public ingest keys or ingest secret hashes.

Orders by snapshot_last_seen DESC, id ASC. event_count is all-time/live; matched_count is the filtered snapshot count. Up to 16 tag.KEY=value query predicates, each key 1..128 characters and value <=512 characters. All filters and tags must match the same stored event. Duplicate non-tag investigation parameters are rejected.

Includes resolved/ignored/muted issues. Events order by received_at DESC, id ASC. issue_id query, if supplied, must equal the path. Up to 16 tag.KEY=value query predicates, each key 1..128 characters and value <=512 characters. All filters and tags must match the same stored event. Duplicate non-tag investigation parameters are rejected.

patch.summary: Resolve, ignore, mute or reopen without deleting evidence
patch.description: Only the status field is accepted. Actual transitions append shared-admin history; repeating a status adds no history.

get.description: Orders by monotonically increasing history id DESC. Only time/pagination filters are allowed. actor=admin does not identify an individual.

Orders by received_at DESC, id ASC; time bounds apply to timestamp, not receipt. Up to 16 tag.KEY=value query predicates, each key 1..128 characters and value <=512 characters. All filters and tags must match the same stored event. Duplicate non-tag investigation parameters are rejected.

get.summary: Read captured JSON or bounded evidence projection
get.description: No projection parameters returns complete stored captured JSON. Any projection parameter selects the bounded form. Check truncated/available_fields_incomplete and nested enrichment flags; missing fields are not proof of absence.
Derived from non-null/non-empty release strings; no release management API. Orders by last_seen DESC, release ASC.

Default last 24 hours, maximum 90 days and 2160 UTC buckets. Pagination is forbidden. total_count is project/range before other filters; matching_count, unique_issues, buckets and breakdowns apply all filters. Empty buckets omitted; top-20 breakdowns include other_count; at most five representative events. Up to 16 tag.KEY=value query predicates, each key 1..128 characters and value <=512 characters. All filters and tags must match the same stored event. Duplicate non-tag investigation parameters are rejected.

get.summary: Read project counts and global processor health
get.description: Project counts are distinct from shared global processor state. pending can mean waiting for a map or resumable work; failed includes permanent evidence errors and retry-exhausted storage failures. Raw error text/storage keys are omitted.

get.summary: Read map metadata, not source contents

put.summary: Register an immutable flat Source Map v3
put.description: Identical retries return 200; first registration returns 201; conflicting normalized content returns 409. Upload invalidates all pending continuation in its project, including unrelated builds; prefer uploading maps before their events. Maximum 2 MiB wire/decoded bytes. A failed registration can retain an unindexed R2 object.

post.description: Use an MCP client, not REST-style calls to individual tools. Nine read-only tools invoke authenticated read handlers; update_issue_status sets unresolved, resolved, ignored, or muted through the authenticated issue PATCH route. No other mutations, OAuth, sessions or GET/SSE subscription. Zod input schemas live in src/mcp.ts; authenticated tools/list advertises JSON Schema. Bodies <=64 KiB. SDK handles protocol negotiation/errors; notifications can return empty 202.

parameters.name: MCP-Protocol-Version
parameters.description: Version negotiated by the official MCP client.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Optional. Must match the Worker origin or permitted CORS_ORIGINS; null is rejected.

SentryQuery.name: sentry_key
SentryQuery.description: Project ingest key with sentry_version=7. Optional backend secret required for secret-enabled projects.

SentryEnvelope.description: Custom scheme carried as dsn in the envelope JSON header, not an Authorization header; OpenAPI cannot natively model body-based authentication.

OTLPIngest.name: X-Bicho-Key
OTLPIngest.description: Existing project public ingest key. Browser keys are public; backend projects can additionally require X-Bicho-Secret. Never authorizes read/admin/MCP operations.

AdminBearer.description: Cloudflare secret BICHO_ADMIN_TOKEN. Missing server configuration fails closed with 503. The shared credential identifies no individual actor.

ProjectId.name: project_id
ProjectId.description: Numeric text project ID, not API version.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Legacy pagination. A nonzero offset cannot accompany a cursor.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this project/endpoint with unchanged filters. Event membership/order are snapshot-scoped; issue states/counts remain live.

From.name: from
From.description: Inclusive occurrence-time lower bound; history uses changed_at. UTC only, Z or +00:00; URL-encode the plus sign.

To.name: to
To.description: Exclusive occurrence-time upper bound. Must be greater than from.

Query.name: q
Query.description: SQLite substring search with ASCII case folding: issue title on issue lists, captured message on event/statistics reads.

Level.name: level
Level.description: Exact level match; SDK levels are fatal/error/warning/info/debug/log.

Status.name: status
Status.description: Optional current issue-status filter; no default on event/statistics reads.

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Comma-separated 1..32 top-level keys matching ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]{0,63}$; constructor/prototype forbidden. Omitted projection fields use up to 32 captured keys.

MaxBytes.name: max_bytes
MaxBytes.description: UTF-8 output budget for event projections, not a character count.

IncludeEnrichment.name: include_enrichment
IncludeEnrichment.description: Only 1 includes derived data; status/error are present in every projection. Plain event reads do not include enrichment.

ContentEncoding.name: Content-Encoding
ContentEncoding.description: Both wire and decoded bodies are independently bounded.

dsn.description: Sentry SDK DSN using this project public ingest key; never an admin credential.

has_more.description: Whether another page exists. Follow next_cursor; next_offset is null on cursor requests even when more results exist.
Whether another page exists. Follow next_cursor; next_offset is null on cursor requests even when more results exist.

EventPayload.description: Credential-filtered captured SDK JSON. Unknown fields are preserved. event_id is normalized; other payload shapes are not reconstructed from D1 metadata.

data.description: Derived source-map evidence. Inspect incomplete, truncated, truncation_reason, processed_frames and per-frame reason/context flags. Projection budgets can shorten nested evidence.

EventRead.description: No projection parameters returns captured JSON; any of fields/max_bytes/include_enrichment selects the evidence projection.

has_more.description: Whether another page exists. Follow next_cursor; next_offset is null on cursor requests even when more results exist.

SourceMap.description: Flat Source Map v3. Runtime additionally validates VLQ values, mapping indices and <=50000 segments. sourcesContent length must match sources; an embedded debug ID must match the path case-insensitively. Source URLs are labels, never fetched.

Error400.description: Invalid identifier, query, body or protocol input.

Error401.description: Missing or invalid admin bearer token.

Error403.description: Invalid ingest credentials or rejected MCP Origin.

Error404.description: Project/resource not found within the requested project.

Error409.description: Debug ID already registered with different map content.

Error413.description: Wire, decoded or output storage byte limit exceeded.

Error429.description: New events exceed the project UTC-hour quota.

Error503.description: Admin secret is absent/empty or an indexed payload is unavailable.

ErrorMcp406.description: Accept must include application/json and text/event-stream.

ErrorMcp500.description: SDK protocol failure or internal Worker error.
